title: C process_dio version-compares across DODAGID/instance
description:
Security review of lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c version compare (post-y4yy). Not a re-file of y4yy/k35h/s0wq. DODAGVersionNumber is per (RPLInstanceID, DODAGID); comparing attacker-controlled version bytes across those namespaces is a hijack.

## Bug

lichen_rpl_dodag_process_dio (dodag.c ~354-365):

- Rejects a JOINED node only when dodag_id differs AND the incoming version is not newer.
- Never compares dio->rpl_instance_id to d->rpl_instance_id.
- If version_is_newer(dio->version, d->version), calls adopt_version, which memcpy's dio->dodag_id and overwrites rpl_instance_id, then wipes parents / rank / role.

So a JOINED node will leave its DODAG when a DIO carries a different DODAGID (or a different instance, even with the same DODAGID) and a lollipop-newer version byte. Version numbers from two DODAGs are not the same counter.

## Attacker model

Authenticated (S=1 / TOFU) neighbor sends a grounded MOP=1 DIO with:

- dodag_id = attacker-chosen
- version = victim.version + 1 (or any RFC-newer value within SEQUENCE_WINDOW)
- rank low enough to win parent selection

Victim adopt_version's onto the attacker's DODAG (global-repair-shaped wipe). SEQUENCE_WINDOW does not stop +1. Rust process_dio rejects instance or DODAGID mismatch with no version compare. Python joined+foreign returns before version_is_newer. rust test foreign_and_incomparable_dios_do_not_change_state is the oracle.

## Acceptance

- JOINED: foreign RPLInstanceID or DODAGID is ignored; do not version-compare or adopt_version.
- UNJOINED first-join to a foreign DODAG may still adopt (Python), but must not use the previous DODAG's version as the comparison key.
- C tests covering foreign instance, foreign DODAGID, and version+1 must not change joined state (Rust/Python expected values).
close_reason: DODAGVersionNumber is scoped to (RPLInstanceID, DODAGID). JOINED + foreign instance or DODAGID returns without version compare or adopt_version (including version+1). UNJOINED first-join to a foreign DODAG adopts without using leftover version bytes. ROOT still ignores all DIOs. Host tests: joined foreign instance/DODAGID with version+1 leave state unchanged; unjoined leftover version 5 adopts foreign version 0; root ignores newer/foreign. Same binary 13/13.
